item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\n\\npolicy=json.load(open('policy.json'))\\nrequests=json.load(open('requests.json'))\\nexpected=json.load(open('report.json'))\\nassert [evaluate(r, policy) for r in requests] == expected\\n\\ncases=[\\n ({'from':'missing','to':'edge'}, policy, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),\\n ({'from':'ready','to':'running','role':'wrong','attempts':0}, policy, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),\\n ({'from':'failed','to':'ready'}, policy, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),\\n ({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':True}, policy, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),\\n ({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':-1}, policy, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),\\n ({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':2}, policy, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),\\n ({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':1}, policy, {'ok':True,'value':'ready','reason':'ok'}),\\n]\\nfor req,pol,want in cases:\\n rb,pb=copy.deepcopy(req),copy.deepcopy(pol)\\n assert evaluate(req,pol)==want, (req,evaluate(req,pol),want)\\n assert req==rb and pol==pb\\nprint('all checks passed')\"]}"}
